trigger: Amazon10 rejected its first real content read: two observed GET200 responses for the same escaped terminal URL; current document query was plus-encoded.

controlled_reproduction.history_without_replacement: Actual GET status was lost and returned null

correction.current_document: Use only its current committed GET request and already observed response from the same explicit read and identical terminal URL.
correction.history: Retain actual method/status while recording the changed document address separately.
correction.superseded_responses: Keep earlier same-terminal-URL GET responses outside the real redirect chain; retain actual redirects.

negative_cases: Different-URL GET cannot borrow an earlier response.
POST cannot borrow an earlier GET; no interaction replay.
Existing redirect, host/path denial, fragment, cancellation and shared acquisition bounds remain tested.
